diagnostic_questions: Does the candidate target advantage appear only at a transient stopping interval?
Is any checkpoint interval target-positive across development training seeds?
At which checkpoints does the candidate satisfy the external-retention guardrail?
decision_rule: Use the curves to diagnose training-seed and stopping-step instability only. Do not promote a recipe or alter a frozen confirmatory decision from this diagnostic alone.
forbidden_uses: changing Stage-B selection or selector objective
using Utility or target-model outcomes as a selector objective
tuning on frozen retention confirmatory holdouts
counting development curves as certification evidence
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
gpu_constraint: physical CUDA device 1, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti only
claim_boundary: Development trajectory evidence only; no deployment, certification, or universal stopping-rule claim.
